description: Plan v7 section 8.3 'fallback entries evaluated under the supplying locale': a Russian catalog is the fallback donor for en, pl, fr and ar requests. Only `ru` carries Items.Fallback / Rank.Fallback / Actor.Fallback / Basket.Alt, so DefaultStrings.getResult (DefaultStrings.java:712) hands `candidateLocale` = ru down to getInternal, which threads it into cardinalityForValue, ordinalityForValue, alternativeMatches and shouldApplyBidiIsolation. Every non-donor catalog also carries Items.Own so the SAME count can be observed resolving locally versus through the donor. instanceLocale is deliberately fr (a loaded, third locale) so that a port which leaks the ambient locale into evaluation is caught separately from one which uses the requested locale. Tiebreakers are null: five loaded locales, five distinct primary language codes.

Items.Fallback.commentary: All six cardinality branches carry self-identifying text so the emitted translation names the category that was actually selected; no case in this family has to depend on a throw to discriminate. Russian's own CLDR set is one/few/many/other, but LocalizedStringValidator does not require a catalog's declared branches to match its locale's category set (only a LocalizedStringWarning.Type.INCOMPLETE_CARDINALITY_TRANSLATIONS warning exists, and the oracle loads with LocalizedStringWarningHandler.ignore()).

Rank.Fallback.commentary: GeneratedCldrPluralData gives ru exactly one ORDINAL rule ('other'), so only ORDINALITY_OTHER is declared. Under English ordinal rules 1/2/3 select ONE/TWO/FEW, which have no branch here, so wrong-locale evaluation fails loudly.

Actor.Fallback.commentary: Gender selection in DefaultStrings is a direct map lookup on the caller's Gender value; no locale is consulted. This entry pins that a fallback cannot change it.

Basket.Alt.commentary: Whole-message alternatives comparing a number against a cardinality constant. ExpressionEvaluator.cardinalityFromOperand classifies itemCount under the locale it is handed, which getInternal receives as candidateLocale.
